about: Fixed prompts for the identity suite (gamma.evals.identity). Each case is answered by the real ConversationService in evaluation mode and scored by an LLM judge against the trait rubric, sycophancy, and turn-format validity. 'expect' holds rubric notes for the judge. Audience defaults to owner_private. seed_facts are fixture facts stored before the turn; they are not real facts about the owner.
